name: Brisbane BNE2 (ex-iseek Brisbane Airport stage 2 / LDR2)

address.note: 2 Cycas Lane per Baxtel/datacentermap. The fire engineer's project page (source 4, read in full) describes 'Stage 2 of the iSeek Data Centre project' at '4 Cycas Lane Brisbane Airport, QLD 4008' - the Stage 2 building may sit on a separately numbered lot. DigiCo PDS (source 7) says only 'Brisbane Airport', 'adjacent to BNE1'.

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '2 Cycas Lane, Brisbane Airport QLD 4008' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Cross-check: the OpenStreetMap building footprint ('DigiCo BNE1, 2, Cycas Lane, Brisbane International Export Pa') is 27m away.

builder.note: A.G. Coombs case study (read in full): 'Builder: FDC Construction & Fitout', client iseek, A.G. Coombs mechanical D&C; completion late 2020. FDC's own 'iSeek Data Centre' page appears to describe the original ~2010 BNE1 build.

developer.note: Developed by iseek; iseek (incl. BNE2) acquired by DigiCo Infrastructure REIT (HMC Capital) at its Dec 2024 IPO (source 7).

mw_it.note: DigiCo PDS (Dec 2024) key metrics for BNE2: Installed IT Capacity 1.7 MW, Future Expansion IT Capacity '-', Planned IT Capacity 1.7 MW; 6,195 m2 land, 1,232 m2 NLA, ~620 racks, Tier IV design, year built 2020. Alternative: iseek's Feb 2019 announcement (source 2) described 'a new 6MW facility being built in its Eagle Farm campus' - probably total facility/power capacity or original design; not IT load as built.

cost_aud_m.note: The widely cited $44m iseek data centre figure relates to the original Brisbane Airport DC (~2010), not LDR2.

authority.note: Commonwealth-leased Brisbane Airport land: building activity needs Airport Lessee Company Consent from Brisbane Airport Corporation and approval of the Airport Building Controller under the Airports (Building Control) Regulations 1996 (source 8, general regime). No record of this specific approval found.

pathway.note: Airports Act 1996 building control (BAC consent + Airport Building Controller) presumed per source 8; specific approval not found.

construction_start.note: Not found. A.G. Coombs mechanical works 'commenced in early 2020' (source 3); main building works may have started earlier. Announced Feb 2019 (source 2).

construction_end.note: 'Completion Date: Late 2020' (A.G. Coombs); SRA Solutions also 'late 2020'; PDS 'Year built 2020' (source 7).

open_questions: scope: excluded - Under 5 MW: DigiCo REIT PDS (Dec 2024) gives BNE2 installed and planned IT capacity of 1.7 MW with no expansion; removed from master.csv and listed in excluded.csv (decision 2026-09-27)
address: 2 vs 4 Cycas Lane for the Stage 2 building
Airports Act (BAC/Airport Building Controller) approval reference and dates not found
